verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents its own scheduling and automation features. Scheduled flags queue a flag change and apply it automatically at a specified future time. Release Pipelines move flags through stages automatically, using triggers and actions, and can generate change requests. Both are one-off or staged flag-change automations, not recurring jobs. missing for 10: recurring/cron-style schedules, scheduling of arbitrary jobs beyond flag changes, evidence that schedules can be created programmatically by agents via API/MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
